identity: Onset U30 supplied grounding lead; reconstructed factory-terminated accessory candidate
selection_status: The Onset terminal supplier, wire gauge, exact profile and lead length are unknown. Ordinary catalog terminals constrain an explicit geometric hypothesis; they are not identified as Onset OEM parts.

sources.facts: Grounding lead is supplied; connect it to the logger ground interface, place its thicker portion in a sensor cable groove and attach its outside end under a mast U-bolt nut.
Black part of ground lead goes in the sensor cable groove. Connect ground wire to the lower housing U-bolt before installing and tightening its nuts.

sources.locations: A41197 revision 05, 21 February 2018; DNFR14-205FIB family row
sources.facts: Ordinary right-angle female terminal reference for 0.205/0.187 x 0.032 inch tabs; 16-14 AWG, nylon housing and tin-plated brass stamping. A 15.24 mm, B 9.40 mm, C 14.73 mm and front housing thickness 5.33 mm. Maximum insulation diameter 4.52 mm. Wire strip 8.7 mm. These dimensions constrain the selected proxy, not Onset OEM identification.

Ordinary 5/16 inch ring-terminal reference: length 28.70 mm, width 11.68 mm, hole 8.64 mm, hole center 22.86 mm from wire-entry end, 0.81 mm tin-plated copper stamping, brass sleeve and nylon housing. Local barrel and crimp profiles remain inferred.

inferences: Selected right-angle termination permits the existing inferred U30 ground tab to be approached without moving the logger interface or box. Onset does not identify this catalog SKU.
Selected 0.400 m conductor centerline, 0.7 mm conductor radius and a separate black 3.8 mm outside-diameter gland sleeve; exact supplied wire construction and dimensions are unknown.

Housing detail, curled contact profile, crimp geometry, insulation color and mating clearances are authored. The supplied accessory is represented as factory terminated; no robot crimping or fabricated electrical continuity is credited.
The selected ring thickness requires a matching 0.81 mm displacement of the lower left mounting nut in this alternative installed state. Washer and U-bolt geometry remain unchanged.
rights: Independently authored geometry; manufacturer documents and drawings are referenced without redistribution. No OEM CAD license or electrical certification is asserted.
